body:
## Pull request overview

Polishes the ObjectUI Console UX by upgrading loading/connection feedback, breadcrumb labeling, empty/error states, and migrating several system admin pages to Shadcn-based components for a more consistent enterprise feel.

**Changes:**
- Enhanced LoadingScreen and ConnectionStatus to provide clearer connection/progress feedback.
- Improved navigation wayfinding (humanized breadcrumbs + system routes + shortened record IDs).
- Upgraded multiple “Not Found”/empty/error views with icons, guidance text, and additional recovery actions; migrated system pages UI to Shadcn components.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/UserManagementPage.tsx | Migrates admin UI to Shadcn Card/Button/Badge and improves empty-state presentation. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/RoleManagementPage.tsx | Same Shadcn + empty-state UX improvements for roles. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/OrgManagementPage.tsx | Same Shadcn + empty-state UX improvements for orgs. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx | Adds page icon + Shadcn Card/Badge empty-state styling for audit logs. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx | Migrates Profile UI to Shadcn Card/Input/Label/Alert/Avatar/Badge and adds avatar section. |
| apps/console/src/components/LoadingScreen.tsx | Adds multi-step loading progress UI and optional message override. |
| apps/console/src/components/ConnectionStatus.tsx | Adds brief “Connected” flash and updates connected icon/visuals. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppHeader.tsx | Humanizes breadcrumb labels, adds system breadcrumb support, shortens record ID display. |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Adds contextual icon + improved empty-state copy for missing dashboards. |
| apps/console/src/components/PageView.tsx | Adds contextual icon + improved empty-state copy for missing pages. |
| apps/console/src/components/ReportView.tsx | Adds contextual icon + improved empty-state copy for missing reports. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Improves missing-object empty state with icon + guidance copy. |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Improves missing-object empty state with icon + guidance copy. |
| apps/console/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx | Adds “Go Home” action alongside “Try Again”. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents Console UX Polish completion and adds Phase 2 UX enhancement roadmap items. |
</details>

The breadcrumb items for `dashboard`/`page`/`report` set `href` to the app root (`/apps/:appName`). Since there isn’t a route for a dashboards/pages/reports index, clicking these links will navigate away (and likely redirect to the first navigation item), which is misleading for a breadcrumb parent. Consider removing the `href` for these items, or add real index routes and link to those.

The success message switched from `role="status"` to the shared `Alert` component, which defaults to `role="alert"` (screen readers may announce it as urgent). For a non-error confirmation, pass `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"` to this `Alert`, or use a component intended for status messaging.
